verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked layout and both move the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow below the body copy, so the reading order is broken. Both also stack the headline over the circle edge. A's headline and copy sit about 12px from the left edge, which is cramped, and it leaves roughly 90px of empty space below the CTA. B has a more comfortable 22px margin and a slightly more even vertical rhythm.

The two are almost the same layout, and in both the eyebrow is demoted below the copy. A's text is jammed about 12px from the left edge. B has a better left margin, but its CTA sits higher and leaves about 95px of dead space at the bottom. B's body text is also slightly smaller.

Both put the bottle on top over the circle, which suits a story-shaped format, but both still put 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the copy. In A the body copy is one long line running nearly to the right edge, the left margin is about 12px, and there is a large gap under the small CTA. B wraps the copy sensibly, keeps a 22px margin, uses a bigger CTA and spaces the stack more evenly.

A simply drops the original square layout into the middle of the tall canvas at its original size. The bottle is tiny, about 110px is empty at the top and about 220px at the bottom, so it was not adapted to the new shape. B reflows the design: bottle on top, then headline, copy and CTA, and it fills the canvas. Its flaws are a tight left margin of about 12px and the eyebrow sitting below the copy.
